prompt: Dark ambient dungeon exploration music for a 1990s first-person fantasy game, for deep caves. Slow, around 75 BPM, in the Phrygian mode. Low brass pads over a soft pulsing low bass note, a slow plucked dulcimer ostinato, eerie high string harmonics, a hand drum softly marking every other bar, an occasional low gong. Sounds like a General MIDI orchestral soundtrack played through a 1990s sound card wavetable: slightly synthetic, clean, no modern cinematic bombast. Steady and unobtrusive so it can play under gameplay, keeping one even texture all the way through: no intro, no big build, no ending or fade-out, as it will loop for as long as the player explores.
